system.description:
This skill allows the character to use common household items to quickly set a building on fire.

Obstacles: Thatched cottage, Ob 1. Munitions dump or powder room, Ob 2. House, Ob 3. Manor, Ob 4. Fortress, Ob 5. Prison, Ob 6. Catacombs, Ob 7. Castle, Ob 8.

Skill Type: Special. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Restrictions: Men and Roden only in character burning

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 257
system.restrictions: Men and Roden only in character burning
